features.heading: From blank page to printed lesson

editor.title: A focused lesson editor
editor.body: Build lessons from named sections, each holding text, images, spelling-word lists and question blocks. Everything autosaves as you go.

ai.title: AI that helps you write
ai.body: Draft passage text, generate question ideas, or spin up a whole lesson concept with built-in AI suggestions, then edit anything to taste.

images.title: Find the perfect picture
images.body: Search free image libraries without leaving the editor and drop an illustration straight into any section.

hub.title: Share to the community hub
hub.body: Publish a lesson for everyone, browse what others have made, and copy any lesson to remix it into your own.

collab.title: Collaborate live
collab.body: Invite a colleague to edit the same lesson in real time, with live cursors and a built-in chat.

export.title: Export anywhere
export.body: Download a finished lesson as a Word document or PDF, or save it straight to Google Docs for printing and sharing.

cta.title: Ready to make your first lesson?
cta.body: No account needed to start building. Sign in only when you want to publish or collaborate.

dashboard.subtitle: Pick up where you left off, or start something new.
